t: This is the Tavistock Clinic, a psychotherapy clinic that is part of the Tavistock and Portman NHS Foundation Trust, based at the Tavistock Centre in Swiss Cottage. The Trust specialises in talking therapies, keeping people supported within their families, friends and workplaces. It also trains thousands of students a year and publishes its own research. The clinic was founded in 1920 by Hugh Crichton-Miller, a Scottish psychiatrist who had earlier set up a nursing home for nervous diseases at Harrow-on-the-Hill.
